name: DPP Conformity Assessment Body (UNTP)
description: Issues UNTP Digital Conformity Credentials to suppliers and manufacturers. On the UNTP trust framework, anchored by a Digital Identity Anchor.
summary: DPP Conformity Assessment Body wallet for workflows/dpp-workflow.md on the UNTP trust framework (role member): the issuers and verifier of noop/dpp_assessment_body, but every DID it verifies must be anchored by a Digital Identity Anchor chained to a registrar it trusts, and it onboards with a DIA from a registrar (untp/registrar) before others can verify what it signs. It issues Digital Conformity Credentials.
